summary.text: Shane Baker is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 85 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner from Somerset, he previously worked as a field representative with the Kentucky Department for Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Shane Baker lives in Somerset, Kentucky.
His career experience includes working as a field representative with the Kentucky Department for Local Government and owning a business.
Baker took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Thomas Turner.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs Committee, the Natural Resources and Energy Committee, and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee, and he is vice chair of the Postsecondary Education Committee.
